coverage: Immutable source validation, typed claims and strict versioned graph profile; original Phase 0 hash unchanged.
Two distinct original accounts and configured roots; copies, alternate characters, mismatched hashes and contradictory authoritative values do not qualify.
Owner, named-account, live Crew and live family access; private boards, details, links and archives; encrypted caller-bound targets/cursors.
Real PostgreSQL observed lock waits in both revocation/read and existing Crew/family kick/read orderings, gate/revoke race, reciprocal link ordering, real family removal during death/heir transition.
Atomic discovery, ACL changes, links, archive references and projection repair; 12 knowledge write rollback boundaries and three discovery fault boundaries, plus unchanged Phase 0 fault cases.
Unknown COMMIT and lost HTTP receipt-store recovery; minimal link/archive receipts do not contain revoked foreign evidence identifiers.
Bounded pages retry if permissions change while acquiring their locks; 4096-unit aggregate rebuild budget and rollback of earlier repairs.
Zero changes to character economy, transaction ledger and item events in the scoped pilot checks.

resolvedFinding.summary: Delayed HTTP completion or cleanup could modify a replaced reservation. Finalization now compares the original body hash and pending status; cleanup compares the original hash.
resolvedFinding.evidenceLimit: Controlled local callback-boundary state transition, not a demonstrated complete concurrent production exploit.

correctedHarness.notes: The test helper expected a target from disabled sharing. It now verifies empty targets and separately asserts the disabled share mutation. Final PostgreSQL run passed.

broaderRepository.notes: The previous Phase 00 full run and its generated knowledge-revision failure remain historical results, not a full Phase 01 pass. The bond-price guard and market-v2 audit-scope failures were rerun in Phase 01 and remain as recorded above.

suiteLedgerEquivalent.notes: A read-only equivalent of the later gate suite-ledger assertions confirms coordination CI coverage but reports three preexisting market-v2 test scripts without CI invocation. No unrelated tests or waivers were changed.

limits: Direct JSON API, no dedicated graphical console or autonomous Agent Act authority.
Independence is between accounts, not proof of distinct humans.
No production load benchmark, exhaustive model checking, broad fuzz campaign or static analyzer execution is claimed.
Sharing target and cursor tokens expire after ten minutes and are process-local; refresh after restart.
No production activation, chain operation, commit, push or changes to existing organization membership.
